name: Hylant

items.verbatim: Hylant Expansion / Class A interior office renovation of the existing 4th floor Hylant office space. Work includes selective demolition, construction of new interior partitions and doors, ceiling modifications, finish upgrades, and associated mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and fire protection mod
